observations: Photo 0 shows the retail box for an SKE Mini UPS.
The brand 'SKE' and 'smart key energy' are visible on the box.
The model 'POE-830P-LFP' is clearly printed on the box.
The box claims a capacity of 20000mAh and LiFePO4 (LFP) battery technology.
Output specifications listed include POE 24V, DC 9V/12V, USB, and Type-C.
The actual UPS device is not shown, only the packaging.
